theorems.statement: ∀ n ℓ : ℕ, ∀ (ζ : Rn n → Rn ℓ) (U : Set (Rn n)) (e : Rn n), IsOpen U → ContDiff ℝ 1 ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ → tsupport ζ ⊆ U → ∀ᶠ h in 𝓝[≠] (0 : ℝ), ContDiff ℝ 1 (fun x => h⁻¹ • (ζ x - ζ (x - h • e))) ∧ HasCompactSupport (fun x => h⁻¹ • (ζ x - ζ (x - h • e))) ∧ tsupport (fun x => h⁻¹ • (ζ x - ζ (x - h • e))) ⊆ U ∧ ∀ y, fderiv ℝ (fun x => h⁻¹ • (ζ x - ζ (x - h • e))) y = h⁻¹ • (fderiv ℝ ζ y - fderiv ℝ ζ (y - h • e))
